---
title: "R Notebook Amplitude for MediaPipe VS Vicon"
---


```{r}
library(readxl)

library(dplyr)

library(tidyr)

library(ggplot2)

library(psych)

install.packages ("writexl")

library(writexl)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# 1) Load data
# -------------------------
AMP_PATH <- "amplitude_WRISTS_MP_scaled_to_mm.xlsx"

amp <- read_excel(AMP_PATH)

# Variable MediaPipe finale en mm
mp_var <- "MP_ampWRISTS_pp_sum_mm"

# Variables Vicon selon projection
vicon_vars <- c(
  "VICON_XY_ampWRISTS_pp_sum_mm",
  "VICON_XZ_ampWRISTS_pp_sum_mm",
  "VICON_YZ_ampWRISTS_pp_sum_mm"
)

# -------------------------
# 2) Fonction stats
# -------------------------
compute_validity <- function(data, mp_col, vicon_col) {
  
  df <- data %>%
    select(all_of(mp_col), all_of(vicon_col)) %>%
    rename(
      MP = all_of(mp_col),
      VICON = all_of(vicon_col)
    ) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  r_test <- cor.test(df$MP, df$VICON, method = "pearson")
  
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((df$MP - df$VICON)^2))
  bias <- mean(df$MP - df$VICON)
  sd_diff <- sd(df$MP - df$VICON)
  loa_lower <- bias - 1.96 * sd_diff
  loa_upper <- bias + 1.96 * sd_diff
  
  icc_res <- psych::ICC(df[, c("MP", "VICON")])

tibble(

  projection = gsub("VICON_|_ampWRISTS_pp_sum_mm", "", vicon_col),

  n = nrow(df),

  r = unname(r_test$estimate),

  p_value = r_test$p.value,

  R2 = unname(r_test$estimate)^2,

  ICC_2_1 = icc_res$results[2, "ICC"],

  ICC_lower = icc_res$results[2, "lower bound"],

  ICC_upper = icc_res$results[2, "upper bound"],

  RMSE = rmse,

  bias_MP_minus_VICON = bias,

  LoA_lower = loa_lower,

  LoA_upper = loa_upper

)
}

# -------------------------
# 3) Stats pour les 3 projections
# -------------------------
amp_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(vicon_vars, function(v) compute_validity(amp, mp_var, v))
)

print(amp_results)

# Sauvegarde résultats
write_xlsx(amp_results, "amplitude_validity_results.xlsx")

# -------------------------
# 4) Format long pour figures
# -------------------------
amp_long <- amp %>%
  select(dyad, condition, pid, all_of(mp_var), all_of(vicon_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(vicon_vars),
    names_to = "projection",
    values_to = "VICON"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    projection = gsub("VICON_|_ampWRISTS_pp_sum_mm", "", projection),
    MP = .data[[mp_var]],
    mean_systems = (MP + VICON) / 2,
    diff_MP_minus_VICON = MP - VICON
  ) %>%
  drop_na(MP, VICON)

# -------------------------
# 5) Scatterplots MP vs Vicon
# -------------------------
p_scatter <- ggplot(amp_long, aes(x = VICON, y = MP)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ projection, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    title = "Wrist amplitude: MediaPipe vs Vicon projections",
    x = "Vicon wrist amplitude (mm)",
    y = "MediaPipe wrist amplitude scaled to mm"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

print(p_scatter)
ggsave("amplitude_scatter_MP_vs_VICON.png", p_scatter, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# -------------------------
# 6) Bland-Altman plots
# -------------------------
p_ba <- ggplot(amp_long, aes(x = mean_systems, y = diff_MP_minus_VICON)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ projection, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    title = "Bland-Altman plots for wrist amplitude",
    x = "Mean of MediaPipe and Vicon amplitude (mm)",
    y = "MediaPipe - Vicon amplitude (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

print(p_ba)
ggsave("amplitude_bland_altman.png", p_ba, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
